fields.label: Landlord Name
fields.description: Full legal name of the landlord / property co-owner as per bank records & PAN.

fields.label: Landlord PAN
fields.description: 10-digit Permanent Account Number (PAN) of the landlord for TDS reporting.

fields.label: Share Ratio (%)
fields.description: Ownership / rent payout entitlement share percentage (total across all landlords must equal 100%).

fields.label: Payment Mode
fields.options:
Sahayog Savings Account
External Bank - NEFT
fields.description: Method of disbursement: Sahayog internal savings account or external bank NEFT.

fields.label: Sahayog Savings A/c No
fields.description: Landlords active savings account number maintained with Sahayog Society.

fields.label: Bank Name
fields.description: Name of the external commercial bank where landlord maintains their account.

fields.label: Bank Account No
fields.description: External bank account number for NEFT / RTGS rent credit.

fields.label: IFSC Code
fields.description: 11-character Indian Financial System Code (IFSC) of the beneficiary bank branch.

fields.label: TDS Applicable
fields.description: Check if Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under Section 194-I is applicable (Mandatory if annual rent > ₹50,000).

fields.label: TDS Rate (%)
fields.description: Applicable percentage rate of TDS deduction (Standard 10% for individuals/HUF).

fields.label: GST Applicable
fields.description: Check if landlord is registered under GST and GST is charged on rent invoice.

fields.label: Landlord GSTIN
fields.description: 15-character Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) of the landlord.
